notes.title: Changelog for Version 1.042
notes.content:
Improvements
S&F Account: When logging into an S&F account, leading and trailing spaces in the account name and password are now ignored. 

Combat: Reward drop chances are now displayed for all rewards in the fight preview screen. 

Heroes:

When all enemies have the “Shroud” status effect, the game will now display shroud info texts above all affected enemies.

Improved some misleading hero skill descriptions.

Events:

The event portal is now properly grayed out when it has not yet been unlocked. 

Clicking on the unlocked event portal while no event is running now provides a short info text. 
Fixed Bugs
Interface/Display: The shimmer icon is no longer displayed on empty hero slots (hero selection in combats and divine alignment in the chapel).

Magic Toilet: During toilet resource spend events, you now instantly see the rewards obtained after spending souls or event souls in draws. 

Disconnections: Fixed an issue that caused unwanted S&F account logouts after a period of inactivity when using SSO methods and keeping the game running in the background. 

Adventure Rank: Clicking the “Reach Adventure Rank 52” quest now correctly opens the adventure screen instead of doing nothing. 

Heroes:

Hephaestus and Taurus no longer grant themselves the status effect “Guard”. 

Fixed an issue where the tongue of Medusa was always visible in the portrait image.

AP bonus increased to 65% for the Rotten Maul (Unique Weapon).

Proc chance increased to 70% at Mythic rarity for the following weapons: Arcane Codex, Clawtastrophe, and Tusk Fang (Unique Weapons).

notes.content:

This item will be available in the Magic Toilet Shop (at the Trader) after the next shop reset!

These boosters will also be available as rewards in some of the upcoming events.

notes.title: New Feature Sneak Peek – Divine Alignment System
notes.content:
The Divine Alignment feature allows you to artificially increase your heroes' levels!

▷ Alignment Slots :flex:

This system has two different types of slots:


 Guardians: Used to define the Alignment Level from the lowest target unit. The slots only allow units of the selected rarity, and the selection is filtered by level, from highest to lowest.
 Blessings: Units in these Slots receive the Alignment Level for the given rarity.


▻ Note: You can still level up your heroes after they have been aligned.

▷ Types of Alignments

There are different alignment categories based on the rarity of the heroes in the slots, with each rarity category having its own unique alignment.

Once you choose your hero’s alignment slots, you must wait for a cooldown before swapping them again with different heroes. Depending on the hero’s rarity, the cooldown and costs for changes may vary.

▻ Note: Alignment System is unlocked as Third Tab in the Chapel on Adventure Rank 15.

notes.title: Equipment Rework Sneak Peek – Smith Improvements 2/3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/5f79241e142ddcf194dee322915b9602a67781df.png

▷ Enhancement

The equipment icon will receive a slight redesign, with item levels now color-coded as follows:

- Unenhanced: White
- Enhanced at least once: Green
- Fully enhanced: Dark Pink

Enhancing equipment will continue to increase its primary and secondary attributes. Additionally, the Dust cost has been reduced, especially for early-game upgrades.

When enhancing an item, you will now see both its current stat improvements and the potential future stat gains from further enhancements. While perks may also improve, unique and set piece perks will remain unchanged.

▻ Breakpoints

As you enhance an item, it will eventually reach a breakpoint, requiring Cinder to unlock the next enhancement stage. Each breakpoint also provides a boost to all standard perk values.

Upon reaching the final breakpoint, the item will receive its highest and last perk value boost. At this stage, it will be marked as fully enhanced, with no further upgrades possible.

◆ Important: Unique and set perks are unaffected by breakpoints, as their values depend solely on item rarity.

This is not the only content planned for the big Equipment Rework Update later this month. Some details may change for balancing. The exact release date will be announced soon—stay tuned!

notes.title: Equipment Rework Sneak Peek – Smith Improvements 1/3
notes.content:
A lot of new changes await you at the smith! At the smith, you can now see which item is equipped to which hero and track its refinement and enhancement progress—and there is much more to come!

We will be splitting the Smith Improvements Sneak Peeks into three parts to thoroughly explain all the upcoming changes over the next few days: Refinement, Enhancement, and Dismantling.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/8e0f736685c4396be42e5e8a8bf1a044f4350509.png
▷ Refinement

Refining equipment upgrades its rarity, increases the number of perk slots, and improves the quality of existing perks. All five equipment types—Weapon, Armor, Headgear, Talisman, and Ring—can be refined.

However, normal equipment, that are not uniques or part of a set, can only be refined twice, allowing for a maximum of two rarity upgrades. Once an item reaches its refinement limit, it cannot be upgraded to a higher rarity.

- Ex.: Rare ⇢ Epic ⇢ Legendary

◆ Important to note: Unique and Set piece equipment have no refinement limit. This means that unique items and set equipment can potentially be upgraded all the way to Mythic rarity.

▻ New Rarity: Mythic

The new rarity after Legendary named „Mythic“ will also be introduced, and will only be achieved through crafting. To obtain a Mythic equipment, you must refine three duplicate Legendary equipment pieces.

▻ Refinement Potential Bars

Equipment pieces now display their refinement potential above their level on the item icon, represented by three Refinement Potential Bars. These bars fill up as the item undergoes refinement, indicating its progression. When all three bars are full, the item has reached its maximum refinement potential. If no bars are filled, the item has not yet been refined in its current state.

- Ex.: A rare Pumpkin Helmet from the Pumpkin set has three empty bars, representing its potential progression from Rare to Epic, then Legendary, and finally Mythic. If the item were uncommon, it could only be refined up to Epic and no further.

This is not the only content planned for the big Equipment Rework Update later this month. Some details may change for balancing. The exact release date will be announced soon—stay tuned!

notes.title: Equipment Rework Sneak Peek – Sets
notes.content:
Get ready for an exciting update to gear mechanics with Sets! Here is a first look at how these powerful new features will allow you for more strategic character builds:

▷ Sets – Exclusive Armor Set Perks!

Sets apply only to armor and do not affect weapons. They grant powerful set perks, such as increased critical chance, damage, defense, and more, when multiple pieces from the same set are equipped. These set perks are available on armor and jewelry of Rare rarity or higher. 

4-piece sets provide perks at different thresholds: when you equip 2, 3, or all 4 pieces. In contrast, 2-piece sets only grant their perk when both pieces are equipped, not when just one piece is worn.

Each set also has a specific name that applies to all its pieces.

- Example: Pumpkin Set = „Pumpkin Chestplate“ + „Pumpkin Helmet“.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/8de34022aaba523573cd78c87181c5b9537c9fa8.png

▻ 2-Piece and 4-Piece Sets

Sets come in either 2-piece or 4-piece combinations, allowing you to equip two different sets on a single hero (2 pieces + 2 pieces).

- 2-piece sets always consist of two specific equipment pieces, such as a helmet and chestplate or a ring and amulet. Armor and jewelry do not exist together in a 2-piece set.
- 4-piece sets, however, can include any combination of equipment, such as a ring, amulet, helmet, and chestplate.

Please note that this is not the only content planned for the big Equipment Rework Update coming later this month. Some of the things you see here may also change for balancing reasons. The exact release date will be announced in due time. Stay tuned for more information on the Equipment Rework!

notes.title: Feature Rework Sneak Peek - Dungeon Proficiency
notes.content:
New improvements are arriving soon concerning dungeons! All dungeons will now require only 2 keys to enter, along with other improvements to enhance your dungeon experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/6c2b933c1176395ffc6299a725e2b2f1cd542e71.png

Proficiency Level & Benefits

In the top-right corner of your dungeon overview, you will see your proficiency level displayed. Level up your Dungeon Proficiency by defeating dungeon bosses to unlock greater rewards and benefits! Each dungeon has its own separate progression bar. The proficiency system consists of 5 levels, each offering unique rewards to enhance your dungeon gameplay, such as:

- Level 1: Speed Multiplier, used to move between rooms faster.
- Level 2: Increased Gold Rewards.
- Level 3: Use double the amount of keys to double your rewards.
- Level 4: Small chance to obtain an extra chest.
- Level 5: Enables Dungeon Auto Mode.

Please note that this feature is planned for release in the near future, with the exact date to be announced in due time. Stay tuned for more updates and exciting content teasers!

notes.title: New Hero Teaser: Cybork
notes.content:
Disclaimer: Please note that this is planned to release soon, just not in the very next update. The skill information may still change before final release. Even more content is coming soon.

A ruthless hero who spreads chaos on the battlefield. Unleashes devastating burning attacks that harm all enemies. Cybork is able to inflict the new status effect “Sludge”, which decreases the victim's resistance and detonates to deal damage when the target is burning. Increases the potential of heroes that inflict Burn.

This Ork took the concept of oil as an energy source a little too literally. Once an ordinary assembly line Ork, he underwent a series of experimental oil enhancements during retraining, causing thick, viscous oil to flow through his veins instead of blood.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/95f539b53e3a429795c5d91c16a32ee0805e8783.png

Overview

Element: Fire
Damage Class: Strength
Rarity: Legendary
Role: Burst DPS, Manipulator

Abilities

Primary: Toxic Waste
- Deals ATK damage to a target and lesser ATK damage to 4 adjacent targets. Inflicts RES Down and has a high chance to inflict Burn.

Secondary: Oil Spill
- Deals ATK damage to all enemies and has a high chance to inflict Sludge. Status “Sludge” = Decreases RES and if Burn is inflicted this status is dispelled and the carrier receives ATK damage.

Ultimate: Purple Death
- Deals 2x ATK damage to all enemies. The first hit inflicts Sludge. The second hit has a chance to inflict Burn.

Get ready to uncover the mysteries of the Cybork! Watch his abilities and synergy burn everything to the ground in one of our upcoming updates – stay tuned for more updates on what is coming next!

notes.title: New Hero Teaser: Shroom Empress
notes.content:
Disclaimer: Please note that this is planned to release soon, just not in the very next update. The skill information may still change before final release. More content is to come for the future.

A versatile heroine capable of slowing her enemies’ AP generation with Sleep and extending the duration of existing debuffs. Increases the potential of other debuffers and manipulators while protecting her own team with Immunity.

Those who linger too long within her invisible veil of spores undergo transformations dictated by her disposition: maddening hallucinations, creeping paralysis, or poisoning that dissolves the body from within are among the milder afflictions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/f274d56af2b5f87793b789afdf4b37e4c236a632.png

Overview

Rarity: Legendary
Element: Water
Damage Class: DEX
Role: Control, Immunizer

Abilities

Primary: Sai
- Deals AGI damage to 3 targets and inflicts Sleep. On a critical hit, the cooldown of the ultimate skill is reduced.

Secondary: Overgrowth
- Deals AGI damage to 3 random enemies. If the target has at least 1 debuff, there is a high chance that the duration of it is increased.

Ultimate: Spore Storm
- Grants Immunity to all allies. Deals AGI damage to all enemies and increases the duration of a random debuff.

Are you excited and curious to find out the secrets of the Shroom Empress? Watch her abilities and synergy with other heroes come to life in one of our future updates – stay tuned for more updates on what’s coming next!

notes.title: Producer's Note #5
notes.content:
With the most recent update, we have revamped the Arena system and introduced the domination leaderboard in the hall of fame. Engaging in the arena's elimination mode not only grants rewards based on your elimination rank but also contributes arena medals towards the domination leaderboard. This allows you to challenge and compete against other players.
Unique Domination Reward
The domination leaderboard offers more than just a chance to compete with others; it also presents exclusive rewards to the top 100 players at the conclusion of an arena season: special frames for your player profile.
The frame remains a constant customization, persisting through changing seasons. However, you have the opportunity to elevate your frame by consistently securing a spot within the same bracket in the top 100 multiple times. With each achievement, the frame undergoes a unique enhancement, becoming increasingly exclusive and radiant. This enhancement process can be repeated up to five times, ensuring a truly remarkable and distinguished frame.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138866/007de0040d90629f5a1beb076112c3e7f30d48cd.png
Issue with Displaying Domination Rewards
We apologize for the current issue regarding the incorrect display of the frame reward, which does not appear as shiny as intended. Rest assured, we are committed to resolving this issue before the conclusion of the ongoing arena season.
Let's Have a Discussion!
We have initiated a dedicated discussion thread in our Discord for the arena feature and cordially invite you to actively share your feedback on this particular aspect. Feel free to express your satisfaction level with the existing system or propose any suggestions for enhancing the arena experience.
